newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia rubber unchanged in slow late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia rubber unchanged in slow late trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were unchanged in slow late trading on Friday, with no deals heard, dealers said.
Dealers said February/March SIR20 offer prices were at 55.25-55.75 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan, 55.00-55.25 fob Surabaya, Padang and Palembang and at 54.50-55.00 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
"There are no deals heard as sellers refuse to lower their offer prices despite the slow demand," one Jakarta dealer said.
Another dealer said there were bids for SIR20 fob Surabaya at 54.75, but there were no deals as sellers were seen holding firm to their offer prices of 55.00 cents.
The dealer also said there were bids at 54.50 for SIR20 fob Jambi, but there were no deals done.
February SIR20 was last traded at 55.00 fob Palembang and Surabaya, but the quantity was relatively small as the purchases were for short-covering, dealers said.
One RSS1 dealer in Medan said RSS1 remained weak at 129-130 U.S. cents/kg on slow demand, adding he last sold RSS1 to European buyers at 129.0/kg late last month.
